required_structure: versioned workbook metadata containing report_attempt_id, snapshot_hash, as_of_utc, timezone and scope fingerprint
SLA member/tier evidence tables with exact persisted row counts
canonical cohort table with exact persisted row count
registered report sections in registry order/version
no live-domain query dependency during writing

writer.input: exact sealed report_attempt_id + snapshot_hash + destination token
writer.read_rule: ReadSealedReportSnapshotForArtifact streams only sealed staged rows in canonical order; writer never queries mutable SR/CPL/policy/other-domain tables
writer.numeric_rule: percentages and durations are rendered from exact integer/rational authority; display formatting never feeds back into tier decisions
writer.failure_rule: writer failure leaves attempt non-completed and produces no CompletedReportEvidence

verifier.input: candidate temporary XLSX + expected sealed snapshot metadata
checks: member/cohort/section counts equal sealed database counts
canonical represented-content digest matches sealed represented data contract
candidate is nonempty and regular file
verifier.result: VALID with filename/sha256/size/verification metadata or INVALID with bounded failure code

publication.temporary_policy: write to a sibling temporary file in the validated destination directory; incomplete temporary files are never presented as completed report artifacts
publication.finalization_policy: after successful verification, atomically rename/replace the verified sibling temporary file to the final chosen filename before or as part of the exact completion protocol; database completion remains conditional on the verified final artifact identity
publication.collision_policy: never silently overwrite an existing unrelated destination. Resolve a collision to a deterministic reviewed unique filename or reject before finalization; replacement is allowed only when the destination is provably the same report-attempt artifact under retry semantics

authority_rules: A written or sealed file is not completed evidence until CompleteSlaReport accepts exact verification metadata.
Completed database snapshot evidence remains immutable if the external file is later moved or deleted.
Artifact generation/export never authorizes deletion, minimization or archival of operational domain records.
